answer: Mutual audit blocks forgery: each epoch a beacon pairs identities with three auditors from the atlas, who stake and vote on its work. A ridge of checkpoints makes fraud crystal-clear; one flag summons five re-audits, and a confirmed fake loses 200 credits. 1,000 puppets stake 200,000 credits and face 3,000 audits per epoch; each exposed one forfeits 200 credits plus fabrication labor. Honest agents stake once and earn audit fees.
